summary: This bill establishes a new tax credit for veterans and their spouses who start small businesses in underserved communities, allowing them to claim 15% of up to $50,000 in qualified start-up expenditures.

scores.thoughts: This bill creates a new tax credit, which reduces government revenue and can be considered a form of indirect government spending or a tax expenditure. While it doesn't involve direct appropriations, it represents a cost to the government.

The core of this bill is the establishment of a new tax credit for veteran-owned small businesses. This credit directly reduces the tax liability for eligible businesses, effectively lowering their taxes.
